title: Post-rollback reconciliation & tenant handoff scratchpad
content:
Scratchpad: Post-rollback reconciliation & tenant handoff (notes to self)

Context:
- Yesterday we flipped model v2025-02-09a -> v2025-02-12b across hosted region-us-west1. Hit increased hallucination signals at 03:10 UTC; manual rollback to v2025-02-09a at 03:42 UTC. Partial client pinning helped reduce surface area, but we still have a handful of tenants on the newer shard.
- Objective: tidy up the state, confirm all tenants are on stable revisions, surface any lingering telemetry, and run a short handoff to CS/Support with reproducible artifacts.

Quick status summary (as of last_modified):
- Rollback completed: yes (control-plane switch + model-router backfill).
- Remaining tenants on new variant: ~6 (ids listed below).
- Primary regression signals: generation-level ROUGE drop + semantic drift flagged by eval-runner for intent_clarify test group.
- Incident ticket: JIRA-RELEASE-8423 (on-call -> eng-release-management)

Open tenant list to chase (run `tenant-list --stalled`):
- tenant-1293 (mobile app beta)
- tenant-4018 (third-party integr)
- tenant-5570 (internal sandbox)
- tenant-6623 (region-eu staging)
- tenant-7700 (analytics partner)
- tenant-8911 (legacy SDK)

Immediate reconciliation checklist (kill-list for today):
1) Verify routing table: `kubectl get svc model-router -o yaml` -> ensure all weights point at v2025-02-09a for us-west1.
2) Confirm KV cache flush status: `redis-cli info` + prefix counts for kvcache:prefix:*; if any tenant has >0 stale prefixes, schedule cache-empty job.
3) Compare token cost delta: run embedding/tokens cost diff for the incident window (03:00-04:30 UTC).
4) Re-run targeted evals on candidate tenants: `eval-runner --suite intent_clarify --tenants tenant-XXXX` (capture logs + artifacts).
5) Reconcile client pin states via control-plane audit logs (control-plane -> /audit/model-pins).
6) Notify Support + CS with a one-liner and attach reproducible requests + expected vs observed outputs (see Communications section below).

Telemetry checks (queries to run):
- latencies: SUM(latency_p50, latency_p95) grouped by tenant for 02:45-04:00 UTC
- hallucination: filter by `eval_label = "hallucination"` and count abnormal spikes by 5-min bin
- quality regression: `quality_regression_alerts` for suite intent_clarify by commit hash
- cache hit rate: KV-cache-hit-rate by model-version and tenant
- model-flip traces: trace id list where routing decision was to v2025-02-12b and client saw degraded output

Rollback reconciliation play (detailed steps):
A. Isolation pass (15-30m)
  - Lock down any automatic rollouts (disable CanaryScheduler for 30m).
  - Snapshot routing config: `redwoodctl routing export --out /tmp/routing-snap-<ts>.json`.
  - Tag events in metrics: post a tag `rollback-2025-02-10` in the metrics pipeline so we can filter.

B. Tenant chase (1-2h)
  - For each tenant still on v2025-02-12b: run `redwoodctl tenant-pin --tenant <id> --version v2025-02-09a --force-access` (note: force-access only for tenants with >1% traffic on new var).
  - If pin fails, open a debug session (`support-shell --tenant <id> --region <region>`) and check SDK version negotiation and client-side overrides.
  - If a tenant is using a custom routing table (older SDK), coordinate with engineering contact to push client patch or apply server-side pin.

C. Validation pass (30-60m)
  - After pinning, trigger synthetic probes that mirror tenant traffic (small sample size): `traffic-probe --tenant <id> --samples 50 --script script/intent_clarify.json`
  - Compare outputs vs baseline (sha: baseline-2025-02-09a). Fail if >10% divergence on intent_clarify metrics.
  - Confirm no elevated error rates or latency regressions for those tenants in the 15m window post-pin.

D. Reconciliation ledger entry
  - Update confluence: small table with tenant id, pinned version, who ran pin, timestamp, and probe verdict (pass/fail). Use `recon-logs/rollback-2025-02-10.csv` as canonical ledger.

Communications (drafts to copy-paste):
- To CS: "Heads-up: We completed a rollback for model flip on 2025-02-10. Affected tenants have been pinned back to v2025-02-09a; we're currently reconciling 6 tenants and will follow up with individual verdicts. If you see any outstanding issues, please escalate to JIRA-RELEASE-8423 and ping me (Leah)."
- To tenants (short): "We rolled back a model update that may have affected some responses earlier today. We have pinned your routing to the prior stable variant and are running quick tests — expected conclusion within 2 hours. Please reach support if you continue to see anomalies."

Postmortem prep notes (what I want to capture for write-up):
- Root cause hypothesis (start with kernel selection differences + quantization path edge-case on longer prefix sequences).
- Timeline of key signals: eval alert -> observation -> rollback decision -> pin operations -> post-checks.
- Which safeguards worked: canary throttle, auto-fallback for dedicated pools; which didn't: client-side pinned SDKs that bypassed server pin fallback.
- Action items: add a forced-eviction path for KV cache on rollback; add a routing audit job; add more probe coverage to intent_clarify suite for longer contexts.

Playbook helpers / one-liners (copyable)
- list tenants on non-default variant: `redwoodctl tenant-list --variant v2025-02-12b --json | jq -r '.[].tenant_id'`
- force-pin tenant: `redwoodctl tenant-pin --tenant $ID --version v2025-02-09a --actor leah --reason "rollback 2025-02-10"`
- fire synthetic probe: `traffic-probe --tenant $ID --script tests/intent_clarify_short.json --out probes/$ID-$(date +%s).json`
- export router snapshot: `redwoodctl routing export --out /tmp/routing-rollback-snap.json`

Risk notes and mitigation ideas:
- Risk: client SDKs with baked-in preferred-variant header ignoring server pins -> Mitigate: server-side honor override flag introduced in control-plane v1.8 (WIP).
- Risk: KV-cache rehydrate causing transient drift when model version flips -> Mitigate: introduce a per-tenant cache version tag and flush-on-rollforward/rollback.

Unresolved questions (for follow-up):
- Were any of the 6 tenants intentionally testing the new variant as part of dev experiments? (ask Solutions Eng)
- Do we have a reproducible minimal prompt that creates the hallucination? Save as repro/hallucination-2025-02-10.txt if found.
- Should we add an automated guard to prevent flips for models with >X% baseline divergence on intent_clarify? (threshold discussion)

Next steps (my todo):
- 1) Chase tenant-1293 + tenant-4018 (Arjun to take 4018 if pinged).
- 2) Run full eval-suite for the new variant on a longer context (Arjun).
- 3) Draft quick postmortem skeleton for the incident page (I'll start outline and fill timeline).
- 4) Add a short note to SDK team about preferred-variant header behavior (Maya to own convo).

Notes to self (brain dump):
- Keep ledger minimal but definitive — it will be the single source of truth for CS handoff.
- If any tenant fails probe, escalate to on-call and consider a per-tenant rollback of client-level toggles (if present).
- Remember to tag metric windows and annotate the graphs with the rollback event marker so PMs/execs can correlate.

End of scratchpad.

Quick links (for me):
- Incident ticket: JIRA-RELEASE-8423
- Router control plane docs: confluence:Routing & Variants
- Eval harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner

Last checked: 2025-02-18 10:12 UTC (manual review by Leah)
